verdict.rationale: Bitbucket ships AI features, including an AI code reviewer, AI-powered pipeline workflows and Rovo, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it can consume external MCP servers. Nothing in the evidence shows it can register or use third-party MCP servers as a client. The Atlassian MCP server [probe-4] exposes Atlassian tools to other agents, which is the separate server-side story and is not credited here.
